key_insight: PolyBO speeds up costly experimental optimization by generating adaptive pseudo-experimental data with a low-capacity polynomial model and using it to guide Bayesian optimization.
engineering_relevance: It can reduce the number of real experiments needed in time-consuming materials, process, or design optimization workflows.
method: Build a polynomial regression surrogate that is adaptively updated as data arrive.
Generate pseudo-experimental data from the surrogate to enrich the training set.
Run Bayesian optimization on the combined real + pseudo dataset to propose the next experiment.
evidence_signal: On synthetic benchmarks, PolyBO reduced optimization time by a median of 42%, and on a real material composition task it reduced time by a median of 96% versus conventional methods.
watch_item: Performance may depend on whether the polynomial surrogate remains sufficiently accurate when only a few real experimental points are available.
paper_title: Optimization of time-consuming experimental conditions using pseudo-experimental data guided by adaptive polynomial regression
